scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm start -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ecom/contracts && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @ecom/contracts && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:client: npm run build -w @ecom/contracts && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ecom/contracts && npm test -w server && node --test scripts/test/deployment.test.mjs
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @ecom/contracts && npm run seed -w server
